text:
Jordan Lee: Heads up - baby arrived early! I'm out starting today. Who should I ping to start the leave payroll/top-up while I'm on paternity? Also need to set up emergency contact updates and make sure my stipend continues.

Priya (People Ops): Congrats Jordan! :tada: Sorry for the rush. We'll flag this as an emergency placement. Please upload the birth certificate when you have it. For payroll/top-up we'll create a retroactive request; finance needs the official leave start date and your preferred top-up percentage. We can process retro pay in the next payroll cycle.

finance-bot: Finance note: to process retro top-up we need: leave start date, employee ID, and approved top-up percent by EOD payroll cutoff. We'll email details.

Jordan Lee: Employee ID 48291, top-up 60%. Start date 2102223333 (today).

Marta (Manager): I'll cover urgent tasks and coordinate on-call. Jordan, do you want a 1-week overlap for handoff after you return?

Jordan Lee: Yes please. I'll aim for 1-week overlap. Thanks.

Priya (People Ops): Also confirming stipend: childcare stipend is pro-rated by weeks on leave; we'll calculate and include with payroll adjustment. We'll confirm totals in 2 business days.

Jordan Lee: Thank you so much. Appreciate the fast help :heart:
